description: Page implementations: rewrite vendor DashboardPage with new 4-stat layout, 65/35 BarChart + fleet utilization, pending approval list, and fleet grid; update VehiclesPage with new filter tabs and status pills; add Accept/Decline buttons to BookingsPage for PENDING vendor bookings; switch EarningsPage chart to BarChart; restyle ProfilePage and SettingsPage; create DocumentsPage placeholder; add /documents route in App.jsx. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 being complete (CSS variables and classes must exist first).
steps: 1. Rewrite src/features/dashboard/DashboardPage.jsx vendor view (keep admin branch unchanged). Add imports: Bar, BarChart, Cell from recharts; ClipboardList, Star from lucide-react; useQueryClient from @tanstack/react-query; useMutation from @tanstack/react-query. Add data derivations: onRentCount = vehicles.filter(v => !v.isAvailable && v.isApproved).length; pendingBookings = bookings.filter(b => b.status === 'PENDING'); sixMonthData = Array.from({length:6}, (_,i) => { const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth()-(5-i), 1); const nextD = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth()-(5-i)+1, 1); return { month: d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{month:'short'}), amount: completedBookings.filter(b => { const bd=new Date(b.endDate); return bd>=d&&bd<nextD }).reduce((s,b)=>s+(b.pricing?.totalAmount||0),0) } }). Add bookingAction mutation: mutationFn: ({id,action}) => api.patch(`/bookings/${id}/${action}`), onSuccess: invalidate vendor-bookings and vendor-vehicles. New vendor JSX structure: (a) page-heading row with h1 'Vendor Dashboard', subtitle showing user?.name + ' · KYC Verified ✓', and lime '+ Add Vehicle' button (primary-button primary-button--fit, onClick navigate('/vehicles')). (b) stats-grid with 4 cards: Total Vehicles (tone='mint', hint='{onRentCount} on rent'), This Month Revenue (tone='dark', badge='+14%', value rupee amount), Pending Requests (ClipboardList icon, tone='mint', hint='Needs action', value=pendingBookings.length), Avg. Rating (Star icon, tone='mint', value='4.8', hint='Avg rating'). (c) div.vendor-dashboard-grid: LEFT panel with BarChart of sixMonthData (Bar dataKey='amount', Cell fill: last bar #111111 all others #D9D9D9, barSize=28, radius=[4,4,0,0]), panel header showing 'Monthly Earnings' h3 + date range small text + total month revenue. RIGHT panel 'Fleet Utilization': three utilization-bar divs (On Rent with fill--rent, Available with fill--avail, Maintenance with fill--maint, widths = percent of total vehicles), overall utilization % footer. (d) Full-width 'Pending Approval' panel: panel__header with count badge, pending-list div showing each pendingBookings item as pending-item with vehicle name/customer/dates on left, Accept button (btn-accept, mutate confirm) and Decline button (btn-decline, mutate cancel) on right. (e) Full-width 'My Fleet' panel: panel__header with '+ Add Vehicle' link (navigate('/vehicles')), vehicle-grid showing first 4 vehicles each as vehicle-card with StatusPill using vehicleStatus(v) helper (AVAILABLE/ON_RENT/MAINTENANCE derived from isAvailable+isApproved), price, edit button. Remove old quick-actions section and secondary stats-grid.

2. Update src/features/vehicles/VehiclesPage.jsx: (a) Change filterOptions to: [{value:'ALL',label:'All'},{value:'ON_RENT',label:'On Rent'},{value:'AVAILABLE',label:'Available'},{value:'MAINTENANCE',label:'Maintenance'}]. (b) Change filter logic: ON_RENT = !v.isAvailable && v.isApproved; AVAILABLE = v.isAvailable; MAINTENANCE = !v.isApproved. (c) Add vehicleStatus helper: (v) => !v.isApproved ? 'MAINTENANCE' : !v.isAvailable ? 'ON_RENT' : 'AVAILABLE'. (d) Replace StatusPill value={v.isApproved ? 'APPROVED' : 'PENDING'} with StatusPill value={vehicleStatus(v)}. All other logic (mutations, form, modal) unchanged.

3. Update src/features/bookings/BookingsPage.jsx: In the action column render function, add a new first check: if (r.status === 'PENDING' && role === 'VENDOR') return
. In the modal actions div, add: {selected.status==='PENDING' && role==='VENDOR' && (<>)}. No other changes.

4. Update src/features/earnings/EarningsPage.jsx: Replace Area, AreaChart imports with Bar, BarChart, Cell from recharts. Replace the AreaChart JSX with: <BarChart data={chartData} barSize={18}><CartesianGrid strokeDasharray='3 3' vertical={false}/><XAxis dataKey='date' tick={{fontSize:11}} interval={4}/><YAxis tick={{fontSize:11}}/><Tooltip formatter={(v)=>[`₹${Number(v).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`,'Revenue']}/><Bar dataKey='amount' radius={[4,4,0,0]}>{chartData.map((_,i)=><Cell key={i} fill={i===chartData.length-1?'#111111':'#D9D9D9'}/>)}</Bar></BarChart>. All data logic, stat cards, vehicle table, payments list unchanged.

5. Rewrite src/features/profile/ProfilePage.jsx as a properly formatted (non-minified) component. Keep all existing imports and data-fetching query. Changes: (a) profile-hero gradient changes to linear-gradient(120deg,#111,#222) via App.css (already done in FEAT-001), so no inline style needed. (b) Add KYC badge: next to business name/role, show ✓ KYC Verified when p.approvalStatus==='APPROVED'. (c) Update icon colors from color='var(--green)' to color='var(--lime)'. Structure: profile-card > profile-hero (avatar, name, business, kyc badge) + profile-details grid (email, phone, business, access).

6. Update src/features/settings/SettingsPage.jsx: (a) Change color='var(--green)' to color='var(--lime)' on the three lucide icons (User, Lock, Bell). (b) Change the Change Password submit button from className='primary-button' with inline width style to className='primary-button primary-button--fit'. All other logic and JSX unchanged.

7. Create src/features/documents/DocumentsPage.jsx: import FileText from lucide-react. Return JSX with page-heading (eyebrow 'Compliance', h1 'Documents', p subtitle), then a panel div with centered FileText icon (size=48, color='var(--lime)'), h3 'Documents coming soon', p.muted 'Document upload and verification will be available in a future update.'

8. Update src/App.jsx: Add import { DocumentsPage } from './features/documents/DocumentsPage'. Add <Route path='documents' element={<DocumentsPage />} /> inside the existing <ProtectedRoute roles={['VENDOR']}> block alongside the other vendor routes.
